initial_scale: RMS of rolling causal forecast residuals at common training-prefix target times; no evaluation targets. Initial paired slow components use these scales.
paired_rule: Fast shortest RMS A; slow per-lead B_h and C_h updated only from e_h and e_short matured at the same target; c_h=A*(B_h/C_h). Shortest c=A. All issued scales frozen; no label comes earlier.
comparison: Paired proper interval score by independent path; all four configurations use the same forecasts, controller clock, learning rates and initial scales. Pointwise MC intervals, not a universal ranking. Any empty/full/overflow invalidates whole score group.
scope: Pilot-informed engineering exploration followed by disjoint confirmatory paths if the candidate is retained. Heavy-tail, persistence and lead-bias cases are stress conditions, not assumed winning examples. Lead bias is deliberate forecast contamination, not a real fitted-model claim.
equal_rate_ablation: paired_equal_rate uses ratio_decay=scale_decay; after matched startup, shared fast and slow shortest components coincide, approaching own-lead RMS. This tests whether two speeds matter, without claiming exact dense-start equivalence.
